svg.title: Data and Skill Progression
svg.desc: A timeline of human learning from conception to 25 years. Prediction moves from egocentric, concrete and sensorimotor, to symbolic, to depersonalized, to abstract. Piaget's sensorimotor, preoperational, concrete operational and formal operational stages overlap like waves. Cortex matures from sensory and motor areas, to parietal and temporal areas, to prefrontal cortex. Milestones run from hearing voices in the womb to hypothetical reasoning and identity. The manuscript compares these phases to the stages of training an AI system.

a.title: Piaget's stages, drawn as overlapping waves

svg.text: overlapping waves, not steps; ages are distributions
each layer becomes a fast subroutine for the next

a.title: The training analogy, from the higher-level overview

svg.text: followed at every stage from 4 years
